title: Elf Bar 600 Banana Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Banana flavour Prefilled Pods are made for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a creamy fruit flavour in a simple pod format. Each pack contains two 2ml pods, each preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and capable of up to 600 puffs depending on usage. Their inhale-activated design makes them straightforward to use, delivering a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw without any complicated settings, refills, or coil replacements. The Banana flavour captures the sweet, mellow taste of ripe Banana, delivering a smooth and comforting vape that tastes rich, full and rounded from first puff to last. Easy to enjoy at any time of day, it’s a straightforward fruit blend that feels familiar and satisfying. Pod replacements are quick and tidy — simply click in a new one when needed.
